task.goal: Delete all but one of any recipes in the Broccoli app that are exact duplicates, ensuring at least one instance of each unique recipe remains
task.final_summary: I found 32 recipes in Broccoli and exactly one pair of true exact duplicates: two "Veggie and Hummus Sandwich" recipes with identical servings (1 serving), time (20 mins), description, ingredients ("varies") and directions. I deleted one of them, leaving 31 recipes with a single copy of each unique recipe. The other same-named recipes are not duplicates, because their servings, times, ingredients or directions differ (for example the three Avocado Toast with Egg entries and the six remaining Veggie and Hummus Sandwich entries all differ in at least one of those fields).

Tap Delete and confirm the deletion dialog
Confirm DELETE on the duplicate recipe and return to list
